briefdescription.para: Definitions of stress scenarios for parser, linker, and retrieval edge testing.

sect1.title: Purpose
sect1.para: Defines the set of edge-case scenarios that the process module must handle gracefully under stress conditions. Used to drive Phase 2 hardening and stress testing.

sect1.title: Scenario Classes
sect1.para:
Stress scenarios are organized into three classes:
Parser Edge Scenarios – Deep nesting, large models, malformed input
Linker Edge Scenarios – Orphaned links, circular references, bulk creation
Retrieval Edge Scenarios – Empty graphs, large contexts, timeouts

Each scenario defines:
Input: Concrete test input specification
Expected Behavior: Deterministic output or error code
Trigger: When to activate (e.g., condition that triggers the scenario)
Success Criteria: Metrics to verify (latency, no deadlock, no silent failure)

sect1.title: Benchmark Expectations
sect1.para: All stress scenarios have associated latency envelopes (P95/P99) that should be validated against release baselines (see PERFORMANCE_EXPECTATIONS.md).
